$comment: US-XC3 golden quest-hydration corpus. `input` is the quest seed (Prolog content + optional runtime status); `expected` is the present-only projection of hydrateQuestFromProlog(input) — see packages/core/scripts/quest-golden-manifest.ts. Regenerate with `npm run quest-goldens`; the C++ port (FInsimulQuestSystem) and the TS drift guard both reproduce `expected` byte-for-byte via the canonical serializer.

cases.name: full_quest5
cases.description: quest/5 main fact + mixed objectives + scalars + rewards + prereqs + tags + completion

input.content:
quest(q_market, 'Bergeron\'s Market', errand, easy, active).
quest_objective(q_market, 0, talk_to(npc_marie, 3)).
quest_objective(q_market, 1, collect(apple, 5)).
quest_objective(q_market, 2, deliver(bread, npc_paul)).
quest_objective(q_market, 3, conversation_turns(4)).
quest_objective(q_market, 4, objective('Chat with the baker')).
quest_assigned_to(q_market, 'Marie Bergeron').
quest_assigned_by(q_market, 'Paul Dubois').
quest_language(q_market, fr).
quest_reward(q_market, experience, 120).
quest_prerequisite(q_market, q_intro).
quest_tag(q_market, errand).
quest_tag(q_market, radiant).
quest_completion(q_market, all_objectives_complete).

cases.name: availability_rule
cases.description: runtime status 'unavailable' + quest/5 'available' + only a 'none' prerequisite promotes to available

input.content:
quest(q_hello, 'Say Hello', tutorial, easy, available).
quest_objective(q_hello, 0, visit_location('Town Square')).
quest_prerequisite(q_hello, none).

quest(q_talk, 'Practice Talking', practice, medium, active).
quest_objective(q_talk, 0, talk_to(npc_luc)).
quest_completion(q_talk, conversation_turns(6)).
